title: Reading digest
description: Fetches an RSS or Atom feed (Hacker News by default), and has Claude pick the five articles that match your interests with a line on why. Appends to reading/digest.md. Edit INTERESTS and the feed address. Add a schedule under ⋯ > Triggers. Needs an Anthropic API key saved as a credential named "anthropic" (⋯ > Credentials).
name: Reading digest

config.system: You are a careful reading assistant. Never invent articles or links.
